title: The Old Ferry
synopsis: The road lamps go out behind the train, and the Hush comes down the valley. Ahead, the old bridge is gone. All that is left is an old ferry on a dark river.
note: The last train runs again tomorrow.
lines: Next stop: River Town. Hold the bar!
The road lamps... they're going out.
There it is. Full steam, now!
The bridge is gone! The river!
Lights off. Let the river take us.
It's looking up the river. Slowly...
The dock bell! It heard us!
It's in the river behind us. Go!
River Town! Thank you, old ferry.
It will be back. Hold the bar.
